info.title: v2.principal.get_clip_video_performance
info.description: Queries video clip performance data for the specified videos within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and video-level detailed metrics.

post.description: Queries video clip performance data for the specified videos within the selected time range. Supports request granularity by day, week, month, quarter, year, or customize, and returns both overall summary metrics and video-level detailed metrics.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency used for amount-based metrics for the specified videos. Limitations: - Optional for every object in video_list. - Supported values are LOCAL and USD. - Invalid currency values are rejected as invalid_parameter. - Defaults to USD when omitted.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Zero-based offset of the first detail record to return. Limitations: - Only supported when video_list is omitted or an empty array. - Default value is 0. - Must be greater than or equal to 0.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Limitations: - Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format. - Must be a valid calendar date. - Must not be earlier than start_date. - Validation is based on the requested timezone. - For customize, end_date must not be later than the day before the current day in the requested timezone. The inclusive date range from start_date to end_date must not exceed 366 days. - For day, end_date must equal start_date. - For week, end_date must be within the selected week range: from start_date (Sunday) to the end of that Sunday-to-Saturday week, or to the latest selectable day if the week extends beyond today. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(startDate + 6 days, today - 1 day). - For month, end_date must be within the selected month: from the 1st day of the month to the last calendar day of that month, or to the latest selectable day for the current month. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(month end, today - 1 day). - For quarter, end_date must be within the selected quarter: from the 1st day of the quarter to the last calendar day of that quarter, or to the latest selectable day for the current quarter. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(quarter end, today - 1 day). - For year, end_date must be within the selected year: from January 1st to December 31st of that year, or to the latest selectable day for the current year. Formally: startDate ≤ endDate ≤ min(Dec 31, today - 1 day).

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Aggregation granularity that determines the validation rules for the requested date range and the reporting period. Limitations: - Supported values are customize, day, week, month, quarter, and year. - customize is validated as a free date range. - day represents a single calendar day. - week requires a Sunday-based calendar week. - month requires a calendar month range. - quarter requires a calendar quarter range. - year requires a calendar year range. - Any other value is rejected as invalid_parameter.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of detail records to return in the current response page. Limitations: - Only supported when video_list is omitted or an empty array. - Default value is 100. - Must be between 1 and 200, inclusive.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: principal_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a principal.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shop identifier that owns the specified videos. Limitations: - Required for every object in video_list. - Must belong to the specified principal_id.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by(depends on different APIs) partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, principal_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of the requested period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Limitations: - Must use the YYYY-MM-DD format. - Must be a valid calendar date. - Must not be later than end_date. - Validation is based on the requested timezone. - The earliest selectable date is calculated as: current day in timezone - 1 day - 2 years. - The exact boundary rules depend on granularity: -- For customize, start_date must not be earlier than the earliest selectable date. -- For day, start_date must equal end_date. -- For week, start_date must be a Sunday. -- For month, start_date must be the first day of the month. -- For quarter, start_date must be the first day of the quarter. -- For year, start_date must be the first day of the year.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone used for date boundary calculation, selectable date validation, and timestamp conversion. Limitations: - Enum values: [\"GMT+7\", \"GMT+8\", \"GMT-3\"] - The API internally normalizes the open API timezone value for video metric queries. - All date validation rules are evaluated in the requested timezone.

parameters.name: video_ids
parameters.description: List of video identifiers to be queried under the specified shop. Limitations: - Required for every object in video_list. - Must contain at least one video_id. - Must contain at most 100 video_ids per object. - Null video_id values are rejected. - Duplicate video_id values across the whole request are rejected. - Across the whole request, the total number of unique video_ids must not exceed 100.

parameters.name: video_list
parameters.description: List of video clip query targets. Limitations: - Must contain at least one object. - Must contain at most 100 objects. - Every shop_id must belong to the specified principal_id. - Duplicate shop_id values are rejected. - Each object must provide a non-empty video_ids list. - Null video_id values are rejected. - Duplicate video_id values across the whole request are rejected. - The total number of unique video_ids across the whole request must not exceed 100.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/principal/get_clip_video_performance?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&principal_id=principal_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "cursor": 100,
    "end_date": "2026-01-31",
    "granularity": "month",
    "page_size": 100,
    "start_date": "2026-01-01",
    "timezone": "GMT+8",
    "video_list": [
        {
            "currency": "LOCAL",
            "shop_id": 181050132,
            "video_ids": [
                1453493,
                1453494
            ]
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: timezone is required
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. timezone field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the timezone field - Fix: Add the "timezone" field to the request body using one of the allowed timezone values: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", "timezone": "GMT+8", ...} 2. timezone value is empty or blank - Cause: The timezone field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " ", the @NotBlank validation detects this - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value, must be selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3", cannot be empty 3. timezone value is null - Cause: timezone is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid timezone value selected from the allowed list: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3" 4. timezone key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "timeZone" (camelCase) or "time_zone", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "timezone" (all lowercase, no underscores) Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: timezone is invalid. allowed values: GMT+7, GMT+8, GMT-3.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1.timezone value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The provided timezone value is not in the allowed timezone list (such as "Asia/Shanghai", "UTC", "GMT+5", etc.) - Fix: Only the following allowed timezone values are supported: "GMT+7", "GMT+8", "GMT-3" Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: granularity is required
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. granularity field is missing from the request body - Cause: The JSON body of the POST request completely lacks the granularity field - Fix: Add the "granularity" field to the request body using one of the allowed granularity values: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", for example {"start_date": "2024-01-15", "end_date": "2024-01-31", "granularity": "day", ...} 2. granularity value is empty or blank - Cause: The granularity field value is an empty string "" or contains only whitespace " ", the @NotBlank validation detects this - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value, must be selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize", cannot be empty 3. granularity value is null - Cause: granularity is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid granularity value selected from the allowed list: "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "year", "customize" 4. granularity key name is misspelled - Cause: Using a different key name, such as "Granularity" or "grain_ularity" or "time_granularity", etc. - Fix: Use the correct key name "granularity" (all lowercase, no underscores) 5. granularity value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The provided granularity value is not in the allowed granularity list (such as "DAILY", "Daily", "hours", etc.) - Fix: Only the following allowed granularity values are supported (case-insensitive, but lowercase is recommended): - "day" - daily aggregation - "week" - weekly aggregation (starting on Sunday) - "month" - monthly aggregation - "quarter" - quarterly aggregation - "year" - yearly aggregation - "customize" - custom date range Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: request body is invalid
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. request body JSON format is invalid - Cause: The JSON sent is incorrectly formatted, such as missing quotes, commas, mismatched brackets, etc. - Fix: Check if the JSON format is valid. Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: page_size is only supported when video_list is empty.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: Explanation: The page_size parameter enables paginated retrieval of video clip metrics. It is only valid when querying across all video clips without specifying specific video IDs. When video_list is provided (non-empty), the API returns data for only those specified clips, making pagination inapplicable. Possible causes: - Both video_list (with specific video IDs) and page_size were provided in the same request. Troubleshooting: - Remove video_list when using page_size to fetch paginated results across all video clips. - Alternatively, remove page_size when querying specific video clips by their IDs in video_list. - For full-scope paginated retrieval: omit video_list, set page_size, and optionally use cursor for subsequent pages. Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: cursor is only supported when video_list is empty.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: Explanation: The cursor parameter enables cursor-based pagination for video clip metrics. It is only valid for full-scope queries where no specific video IDs are filtered. Possible causes: - A cursor value was provided together with a non-empty video_list. Troubleshooting: - Omit video_list when using cursor for pagination across all video clips. - To query specific video clips, remove both page_size and cursor, and provide video IDs in video_list. - For full-scope paginated retrieval: omit video_list, set page_size, and use the returned cursor in subsequent requests. Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: shop_id is required
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. An element in the request list is missing the shop_id field 2. shop_id value is null - Fix: Provide a valid non-null shop_id value 3. shop_id key name is misspelled - Fix: Use "shop_id", not "shopId" or "shop-id" Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: currency is invalid
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. currency value is not in the allowed list - Cause: The currency field value in a shop object in shop_list is not an allowed currency type, system throws exception when calling CurrencyEnum.valueOf() - Fix: currency supports only two values (case-insensitive): "usd" or "local". For example {"shop_id": 123456, "currency": "usd"} or {"shop_id": 123456, "currency": "local"} Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: video_ids is required
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. an element in video_list is missing the video_ids field - Cause: A video object in the video_list array does not have the video_ids field - Fix: Ensure each object in video_list contains the video_ids field, format: {"shop_id": 123456, "video_ids": [7001, 7002]} 2. video_ids is an empty array - Cause: The video_ids field exists but its value is an empty array [] - Fix: Provide at least one video_id for each video object, video_ids cannot be empty 3. video_ids value is null - Cause: video_ids is explicitly set to null - Fix: Provide a valid video ID list array, cannot be null Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: end_date is not ready, please retry later
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. the data corresponding to the requested end_date is still being processed and has not completed - Cause: The dashboard data update on the data platform has a delay (usually T-1 or T-2). The data corresponding to the end_date of the current request is still being processed. - Fix: Retry the request later. Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: for day granularity, start_date must equal end_date.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. start_date and end_date are not the same when using day granularity - Cause: When granularity is "day", the system requires querying data for a single date, therefore start_date and end_date must be the same - Fix: Set start_date and end_date to the same date. For example, if you want to query daily data for 2024-01-15, set "start_date": "2024-01-15" and "end_date": "2024-01-15" Show more

x-shopee-error-codes.Error Description: day range is outside the allowed selectable range.
x-shopee-error-codes.Details and Guidance: 1. selected date is earlier than the earliest allowed date (2 years ago) - Cause: The earliest date allowed for querying is 2 years before the current date (calculated according to the timezone). If start_date (for day granularity, start_date must equal end_date) is earlier than this date, this error is triggered - Fix: The selected date must be within the last 2 years. For example, if today is 2026-06-29, the earliest allowed date for querying is 2024-06-28. Ensure both start_date and end_date are not earlier than that date 2. selected date is later than the latest allowed date (yesterday) - Cause: Open API data has a 1-day delay. The latest date allowed for querying is yesterday. If start_date or end_date is today or a future date, this error is triggered - Fix: You can only query data up to yesterday.
